notes: this is the compiler's own statement of how he holds the book's material from علي بن حسان, not a saying; the two «و رويته» clauses are two routes to the same man, so two groups
«أبي» is the compiler's father, unnamed: relation; «محمد بن الحسن» (occurrence 1) and «محمد بن الحسن الصفار» are two men written in succession (rule 7), so they stay two links
the blessings «رضي اللّه عنه» are left out
